judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete and stops halfway through its own Definition of Done without modifying `messageHandler.ts` or `createServer.ts`, causing its own acceptance tests to fail. Furthermore, it invents its own message and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of using the ones explicitly required by the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It also violates multiple core requirements: it modifies an existing line in `src/types/messages.ts`, allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation instead of restricting to 1–200, and plans to return an empty list when `listFor` is missing instead of the required `UNSUPPORTED` error code. Finally, it completely omits the `transport.history` opt-in configuration, `StoreCannotList`, and all documentation/changelog updates.
